veranderings.blok: Stysel in die kos wat ons eet
veranderings.voor: 'n Gekookte eier en 'n stukkie gewone blokkaas bly dus bruin in die jodiumtoets.
veranderings.na: Op 'n gekookte eier en 'n stukkie gewone blokkaas bly die jodiumoplossing dus bruin.
veranderings.rede: As written the egg and cheese themselves 'stay brown', but it is the iodine solution that stays brown on them; the protected 'gewone blokkaas' is kept.

veranderings.na: dié in die suikerpot by die huis
veranderings.rede: The lesson addresses the learner as 'jy' throughout, so the sudden plural 'julle' is inconsistent; this keeps the household meaning.
